pages.text: White snow covered the slope. The children lined up with their sleds. They pushed the sled in front of them.
Ppino was at the very back. "I want to go first."
Ppino slipped in front of Mei. Mei was pushed back in the line.
Ppino cut in front of Soso too. "I'm first."
Ppino stood at the front and set the sled down on the slope.
But nobody behind Ppino gave a push. The sled didn't move at all.
Ppino pushed with one foot. The sled tipped and got stuck in the snow.
Grandma Bear helped Ppino up. "A sled needs a push from behind to get going."
Ppino stood at the back of the line. The others went down one at a time.
All four pushed together from behind. Ppino went the farthest of all.
